+# MobileIE Assets Fusion Improvements - 2026-06-03
+
+## Goal
+
+Further improve PSNR/SSIM on the 24 paired `assets/data` cases while keeping the
+evaluation protocol explicit. The 24 images are still not used as a conventional
+training split. This report separates:
+
+- strict no-GT inference results,
+- leave-one-out cross-validation results on the 24 assets pairs,
+- oracle upper-bound analysis that uses all 24 GT images to fit fusion weights.
+
+The main empirical finding is that the pretrained MobileIE outputs are over-bright
+for this local test set. Preserving part of the original input structure and fusing
+multiple enhancement outputs increases both PSNR and SSIM substantially.
+
+## Paper Motivation
+
+- Zero-DCE frames enhancement as image-specific curve estimation and uses
+  no-reference losses for exposure, color, spatial consistency, and illumination
+  smoothness. This motivated the earlier `zero_refine_mobileie.py` stage.
+- SNR-Aware LLIE uses signal-to-noise priors to guide spatially varying enhancement.
+  This motivated the SNR-gated curve refinement and the later observation that
+  dark/noisy regions should not be blindly amplified.
+- Retinexformer estimates illumination, enhances the low-light image, and restores
+  corruption in a one-stage framework. This motivated treating illumination/exposure
+  correction and corruption/structure preservation as separate concerns.
+
+References:
+
+- Zero-DCE, CVPR 2020:
+  https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content_CVPR_2020/html/Guo_Zero-Reference_Deep_Curve_Estimation_for_Low-Light_Image_Enhancement_CVPR_2020_paper.html
+- SNR-Aware Low-Light Image Enhancement, CVPR 2022:
+  https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2022/html/Xu_SNR-Aware_Low-Light_Image_Enhancement_CVPR_2022_paper.html
+- Retinexformer, ICCV 2023:
+  https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2023/html/Cai_Retinexformer_One-stage_Retinex-based_Transformer_for_Low-light_Image_Enhancement_ICCV_2023_paper.html
+
+## Implemented Tooling
+
+New script:
+
+- `tools/fuse_enhancements.py`
+
+Supported modes:
+
+- `fixed`: apply user-provided global weights without GT.
+- `fit-convex`: fit nonnegative simplex weights with GT over the provided set.
+- `loo-convex`: leave-one-out convex weight fitting.
+- `fit-linear`: unconstrained linear least-squares fusion with GT.
+- `loo-linear`: leave-one-out unconstrained linear least-squares fusion.
+
+The script writes fused images, per-case metrics, summaries, and the fitted weights.
+
+Unit tests:
+
+- `tests/test_fuse_enhancements.py`
+
+## Results
+
+All rows below are evaluated on all 24 assets cases.
+
+| Category | Variant | PSNR | SSIM | Mean luma | Notes |
+| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
+| Baseline | input | 12.4243 | 0.2207 | 0.0511 | Raw low-light input |
+| Baseline | lolv1 | 15.1297 | 0.4649 | 0.4046 | Over-bright for this GT |
+| Baseline | lolv2_pretrained | 15.2003 | 0.4622 | 0.4110 | Over-bright for this GT |
+| No-reference TTA | zero_t014_snr | 16.9874 | 0.5011 | 0.3224 | Zero-DCE-style curve refinement |
+| Fixed fusion | fixed_input040_lolv1060 | 19.6504 | 0.5543 | 0.2631 | 0.4 input + 0.6 lolv1 |
+| LOO-CV | loo_convex_input_lolv1 | 19.5915 | 0.5553 | 0.2604 | Each case uses weights fit on the other 23 |
+| LOO-CV | loo_linear7 | 20.4253 | 0.5702 | 0.2553 | 7-source linear fusion, fit on other 23 |
+| Oracle | oracle_linear7 | 20.8148 | 0.5801 | 0.2564 | Uses all 24 GT images to fit weights |
+
+Important interpretation:
+
+- `zero_t014_snr` is the strongest strict no-reference test-time result currently
+  implemented.
+- `fixed_input040_lolv1060` performs no GT use at inference, but the weight was chosen
+  after analyzing this assets set. Use it as a practical project setting, not as a
+  locked-test generalization claim.
+- `loo_convex_input_lolv1` and `loo_linear7` are better protocol examples for showing
+  target-domain calibration without using the held-out case's GT.
+- `oracle_linear7` is an upper bound, not a fair test result.
+
+## Why Fusion Helps
+
+The GT mean luma on assets is about `0.2496`, while LOL-v1/LOL-v2 pretrained outputs
+have mean luma around `0.40`. The best fusion outputs reduce mean luma to about
+`0.255-0.263`, much closer to GT. They also preserve dark-region structure from the
+input instead of amplifying all low-light pixels.
+
+The stable LOO convex weights are:
+
+- mean input weight: `0.4079`
+- mean lolv1 weight: `0.5921`
+- standard deviation: about `0.005` for both weights
+
+This stability is why the simple fixed `0.4 input + 0.6 lolv1` blend works almost as
+well as LOO fitting.
+

+`input`, `lolv1`, `zero_t014`, `fixed040`, `loo7`, `oracle7`, `gt`

+## Paper Ideas Used

+  Implemented in `tools/zero_refine_mobileie.py` as a per-image iterative curve

+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+
+class CalibratedLLE(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, base_model, channels=16, residual_scale=0.2):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.base_model = base_model
+        self.residual_scale = residual_scale
+        for param in self.base_model.parameters():
+            param.requires_grad = False
+
+        self.head = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Conv2d(11, channels, 3, 1, 1),
+            nn.PReLU(channels),
+            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, 1, 1),
+            nn.PReLU(channels),
+            nn.Conv2d(channels, 3, 1, 1, 0),
+        )
+        nn.init.zeros_(self.head[-1].weight)
+        nn.init.zeros_(self.head[-1].bias)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            base = self.base_model(x).clamp(0, 1)
+        luma_in = self._luma(x)
+        luma_base = self._luma(base)
+        features = torch.cat([x, base, base - x, luma_in, luma_base], dim=1)
+        residual = torch.tanh(self.head(features)) * self.residual_scale
+        return (base + residual).clamp(0, 1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _luma(x):
+        r = x[:, 0:1]
+        g = x[:, 1:2]
+        b = x[:, 2:3]
+        return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b

+def infer(model, rgb, device):
+    arr = rgb.astype(np.float32) / 255.0
+    x = torch.from_numpy(arr.transpose(2, 0, 1)).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        out = model(x).clamp(0, 1)[0].permute(1, 2, 0).detach().cpu().numpy()
+    return (out * 255.0).round().astype(np.uint8)
+
+

+    image_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    model = build_model(args)

+    rows = []

+        inp = load_rgb_uint8(input_path)

+            gt = load_rgb_uint8(gt_path)

+            gt_float = gt.astype(np.float32) / 255.0

+def parse_named_weights(specs, labels):

+            raise ValueError(f"Weight must be label=value, got {spec!r}")
+        label, value = spec.split("=", 1)
+        by_name[label] = float(value)
+    missing = [label for label in labels if label not in by_name]
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing weights for labels: {', '.join(missing)}")
+    return np.array([by_name[label] for label in labels], dtype=np.float64)

+def blend_float_images(images, weights):
+    if len(images) != len(weights):
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected {len(weights)} images, got {len(images)}")
+    out = np.zeros_like(images[0], dtype=np.float64)
+    for image, weight in zip(images, weights):
+        out += float(weight) * image.astype(np.float64)
+    return np.clip(out, 0.0, 1.0).astype(np.float32)

+
+def find_matching_image(directory, image_path):
+    candidate = Path(directory) / image_path.name
+    if candidate.exists():
+        return candidate
+    matches = [path for path in Path(directory).iterdir() if path.stem == image_path.stem and path.suffix.lower() in {".bmp", ".jpeg", ".jpg", ".png", ".tif", ".tiff", ".webp"}]
+    if not matches:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No matching image for {image_path.name} in {directory}")
+    return matches[0]
+
+
+def compute_image_moments(images, gt):
+    flat_gt = gt.reshape(-1).astype(np.float64)
+    flat_images = [image.reshape(-1).astype(np.float64) for image in images]
+    count = flat_gt.size
+    moments_a = np.zeros((len(images), len(images)), dtype=np.float64)
+    moments_b = np.zeros(len(images), dtype=np.float64)
+    for idx, flat in enumerate(flat_images):
+        moments_b[idx] = float(flat @ flat_gt)
+        for jdx in range(idx, len(flat_images)):
+            value = float(flat @ flat_images[jdx])
+            moments_a[idx, jdx] = value
+            moments_a[jdx, idx] = value
+    gt_energy = float(flat_gt @ flat_gt)
+    return {"a": moments_a, "b": moments_b, "gt_energy": gt_energy, "count": count}
+
+
+def normalize_moments(raw_a, raw_b, count):
+    return raw_a / count, raw_b / count
+
+
+def _simplex_parts(dimensions, total):
+    if dimensions == 1:
+        yield (total,)
+        return
+    for value in range(total + 1):
+        for rest in _simplex_parts(dimensions - 1, total - value):
+            yield (value,) + rest
+
+
+def prepare_cases(sources, gt_dir):
+    labels = [label for label, _ in sources]
+    first_dir = sources[0][1]
+    cases = []
+    for image_path in list_images(first_dir):
+        source_images = []
+        for _, source_dir in sources:
+            matched = find_matching_image(source_dir, image_path)
+            source_images.append(image_to_float(load_rgb_uint8(matched)))
+        gt = None
+        if gt_dir:
+            gt = image_to_float(load_rgb_uint8(find_matching_image(gt_dir, image_path)))
+        cases.append({"name": image_path.name, "sources": source_images, "gt": gt, "labels": labels})
+    if not cases:
+        raise ValueError(f"No images found in {first_dir}")
+    return cases
+
+
+def build_weights(args, cases, labels):
+    fit_indices = [labels.index(label) for label in args.fit_label] if args.fit_label else list(range(len(labels)))
+    fixed = None
+    if args.mode == "fixed":
+        fixed = parse_named_weights(args.weight, labels)
+        return [fixed for _ in cases], {"mode": args.mode, "labels": labels, "weights": fixed.tolist()}
+
+    if any(case["gt"] is None for case in cases):
+        raise ValueError(f"Mode {args.mode} requires --gt-dir")
+
+    moments = [compute_image_moments(case["sources"], case["gt"]) for case in cases]
+    total_a = sum(item["a"] for item in moments)
+    total_b = sum(item["b"] for item in moments)
+    total_count = sum(item["count"] for item in moments)
+
+    def fit(a_raw, b_raw, count):
+        a, b = normalize_moments(a_raw, b_raw, count)
+        if args.mode.endswith("convex"):
+            return fit_convex_weights(a, b, fit_indices=fit_indices, grid_steps=args.grid_steps)
+        return fit_linear_weights(a, b, ridge=args.ridge)
+
+    if args.mode.startswith("fit"):
+        weights = fit(total_a, total_b, total_count)
+        return [weights for _ in cases], {
+            "mode": args.mode,
+            "labels": labels,
+            "fit_labels": args.fit_label or labels,
+            "weights": weights.tolist(),
+        }
+
+    per_case_weights = []
+    per_case_records = []
+    for case, item in zip(cases, moments):
+        weights = fit(total_a - item["a"], total_b - item["b"], total_count - item["count"])
+        per_case_weights.append(weights)
+        per_case_records.append({"image": case["name"], "weights": dict(zip(labels, [float(value) for value in weights]))})
+    return per_case_weights, {
+        "mode": args.mode,
+        "labels": labels,
+        "fit_labels": args.fit_label or labels,
+        "per_image": per_case_records,
+        "mean_weights": dict(zip(labels, [float(value) for value in np.mean(np.stack(per_case_weights), axis=0)])),
+        "std_weights": dict(zip(labels, [float(value) for value in np.std(np.stack(per_case_weights), axis=0)])),
+    }
+
+
+def write_outputs(args, cases, weights_by_case, weights_metadata):
+    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
+    image_dir = output_dir / args.variant
+    image_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    rows = []
+    labels = cases[0]["labels"]
+
+    for idx, (case, weights) in enumerate(zip(cases, weights_by_case), 1):
+        out = blend_float_images(case["sources"], weights)
+        out_uint8 = float_to_uint8(out)
+        save_rgb_uint8(image_dir / case["name"], out_uint8)
+        row = {"image": case["name"], "variant": args.variant}
+        for label, weight in zip(labels, weights):
+            row[f"weight_{label}"] = float(weight)
+        row.update(summarize_rgb_uint8(out_uint8))
+        if case["gt"] is not None:
+            row["psnr"] = psnr_float(out, case["gt"])
+            row["ssim"] = float(structural_similarity(case["gt"], out, channel_axis=2, data_range=1.0))
+        rows.append(row)
+        if args.progress_every and (idx % args.progress_every == 0 or idx == len(cases)):
+            print(json.dumps({"processed": idx, "total": len(cases)}), flush=True)
+
+    fieldnames = sorted({key for row in rows for key in row})
+    with open(output_dir / f"{args.variant}_metrics.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fieldnames)
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+
+    summary = {
+        args.variant: {
+            "num_images": len(rows),
+            "mean_luma": float(np.mean([row["mean_luma"] for row in rows])),
+            "bright_frac_gt_095": float(np.mean([row["bright_frac_gt_095"] for row in rows])),
+            "entropy_luma": float(np.mean([row["entropy_luma"] for row in rows])),
+            "weights_metadata": weights_metadata,
+        }
+    }
+    if "psnr" in rows[0]:
+        summary[args.variant]["psnr"] = float(np.mean([row["psnr"] for row in rows]))
+        summary[args.variant]["ssim"] = float(np.mean([row["ssim"] for row in rows]))
+
+    with open(output_dir / f"{args.variant}_summary.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        json.dump(summary, handle, indent=2)

+        json.dump(weights_metadata, handle, indent=2)

+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--source", action="append", required=True, help="Repeat as label=directory")
+    parser.add_argument("--gt-dir")
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--variant", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=["fixed", "fit-convex", "loo-convex", "fit-linear", "loo-linear"], default="fixed")
+    parser.add_argument("--weight", action="append", default=[], help="For --mode fixed: label=value")
+    parser.add_argument("--fit-label", action="append", default=[], help="Restrict fitted convex weights to these labels")
+    parser.add_argument("--grid-steps", type=int, default=100)
+    parser.add_argument("--ridge", type=float, default=1e-8)
+    parser.add_argument("--progress-every", type=int, default=8)

+    sources = [parse_source_spec(spec) for spec in args.source]

+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+
+IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {".bmp", ".jpeg", ".jpg", ".png", ".tif", ".tiff", ".webp"}
+
+
+def list_images(path):
+    root = Path(path)
+    return sorted(p for p in root.iterdir() if p.suffix.lower() in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS)
+
+
+def rgb_to_luma(rgb_float):
+    return (
+        0.2126 * rgb_float[..., 0]
+        + 0.7152 * rgb_float[..., 1]
+        + 0.0722 * rgb_float[..., 2]
+    )
+
+
+def summarize_rgb_uint8(rgb):
+    arr = rgb.astype(np.float32) / 255.0
+    y = rgb_to_luma(arr)
+    maxc = arr.max(axis=2)
+    minc = arr.min(axis=2)
+    saturation = np.where(maxc > 1e-6, (maxc - minc) / np.maximum(maxc, 1e-6), 0.0)
+    hist, _ = np.histogram((y * 255).clip(0, 255).astype(np.uint8), bins=256, range=(0, 255), density=True)
+    hist = hist[hist > 0]
+    entropy = float(-(hist * np.log2(hist)).sum()) if hist.size else 0.0
+    dy = np.diff(y, axis=0)
+    dx = np.diff(y, axis=1)
+
+    return {
+        "mean_luma": float(y.mean()),
+        "std_luma": float(y.std()),
+        "p01_luma": float(np.quantile(y, 0.01)),
+        "p99_luma": float(np.quantile(y, 0.99)),
+        "dark_frac_lt_005": float((y < 0.05).mean()),
+        "bright_frac_gt_095": float((y > 0.95).mean()),
+        "mean_saturation": float(saturation.mean()),
+        "entropy_luma": entropy,
+        "gradient_energy": float(np.mean(dx * dx) + np.mean(dy * dy)),
+    }
+
+
+def apply_exposure_gate(input_rgb, enhanced_rgb, luma_threshold=0.2):
+    input_summary = summarize_rgb_uint8(input_rgb)
+    if input_summary["mean_luma"] >= luma_threshold:
+        return input_rgb, "keep_input"
+    return enhanced_rgb, "use_enhanced"
+
+
+def psnr_float(output, target):
+    mse = float(np.mean((output.astype(np.float32) - target.astype(np.float32)) ** 2))
+    if mse <= 1e-12:
+        return math.inf
+    return float(10.0 * math.log10(1.0 / mse))
+
+
+def load_rgb_uint8(path):
+    return np.array(Image.open(path).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.uint8)
+
+
+def save_rgb_uint8(path, rgb):
+    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    Image.fromarray(rgb).save(path)
+
+
+def compose_comparison_panel(named_images, tile_size=(320, 213), label_height=28, margin=8):
+    width = margin + len(named_images) * (tile_size[0] + margin)
+    height = margin + label_height + tile_size[1] + margin
+    panel = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), "white")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(panel)
+
+    for index, (label, rgb) in enumerate(named_images):
+        tile = Image.fromarray(rgb).convert("RGB")
+        tile.thumbnail(tile_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+        x = margin + index * (tile_size[0] + margin)
+        y = margin
+        draw.text((x, y), label, fill=(0, 0, 0))
+        paste_x = x + (tile_size[0] - tile.width) // 2
+        paste_y = y + label_height + (tile_size[1] - tile.height) // 2
+        panel.paste(tile, (paste_x, paste_y))
+    return panel

+def color_constancy_loss(x):

+def spatial_consistency_loss(inp, out):

+        dst = out_y
+        if dy == 1:
